text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — the scheduled nightly 'bench-rotation' job failed on gpu-3. It hit OOM during the embed step. Job ID: 98765. Can someone triage?
Arjun Patel: paste the error/log snippet?
Maria Chen: here it is (tail of log):
```
[2026-03-17 03:00:12] allocate_tensor: trying to alloc 1.2GiB -> OOM, exit code: 137
[2026-03-17 03:00:12] runtime: GPU 3 memory usage 98%
stack: serve/inference/embeds.cpp:line 402
```
Linh Tran: ugh. Is this happening every run or intermittent?
Maria Chen: reran once manually on gpu-3 and it repros consistently. CPU run passes.
CI Bot: Job 98765 failed: exit code 137 (OOM) — auto-notify posted.
Zach Thomas: could be a regression from the quantization/kvcache change pushed yesterday (commit abc123). Any chance that landed into the nightly model refresh?
Maria Chen: the nightly refresh pulled models from `main` at abc123 around 01:45 UTC, yes.
Arjun Patel: quick triage plan: 1) rerun with smaller batch, 2) enable memory profiling, 3) if still repro, bisect commits in model refresh.
Linh Tran: I can bisect if you want. Suggest first try `--batch-size=1` and `--profile-memory` flags. Command: `./run_bench --job-id=98765 --batch-size=1 --profile-memory`
QA Bot: memory profiler enabled will upload heap dump to s3://redwood-ci/heapdumps/98765/ if OOM occurs.
Maria Chen: starting a controlled rerun with batch=1 and profile now. ETA ~10m.
Linh Tran: if that still OOMs, I’ll start a git bisect across the model refresh commits (range def456..abc123). I’ll ping infra if we need a different GPU shape.
Arjun Patel: also add `--max-seq=256` as quick safeguard in case input lengths spiked.
Maria Chen: good call. Running with batch=1 + max-seq=256 + profile. Link to job: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/98766 (live).
Zach Thomas: if bisect needed: start with `git bisect start && git bisect bad abc123 && git bisect good def456` then run the minimal reproduce script per commit.
CI Bot: Rerun 98766 queued on gpu-7 (isolation).
Maria Chen: update — rerun failed again with OOM, heapdump uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/heapdumps/98766/heap-20260317-0312.tar.gz
Linh Tran: okay taking bisect. I’ll run parallel bisect workers on two GPUs to speed up. Tagging @Arjun for test harness tweaks.
Arjun Patel: noted. I’ll add a narrower reproduce harness to the bisect script to avoid long runs.
Maria Chen: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Please leave notes in the job thread when you have findings. :thumbsup:
Linh Tran: will report back in this thread with the culprit commit or a mitigation by EOD.
Zach Thomas: thanks, team. If it's a model artifact we can pin the previous model on nightly until fixed.
Maria Chen: agreed — if bisect shows model change, we’ll pin and roll a hotfix.
QA Bot: I’ll mark the nightly job as flaky until we resolve to avoid noisy alerts.
Maria Chen: ACK, thanks.
